subtitle: Talent Command — Tree Navigator, Source Paths & Point Sandbox
changes: Added Talent Command Center with all-pool Blizzard talent search, source-ID navigation and selected/review-linked talent filters.
Added bounded upstream source-path exploration and direct native talent tree spotlight and rank inspection.
Added a non-destructive point sandbox showing proposed rank, category total and source-link review impact before an explicit user-applied change.
Added native rank-control handoff so applied previews honor original undo/redo, local auto-recovery and manual talent draft limits.
Added visible source-link counts to talent nodes and optional focus highlighting for reported connections without changing Blizzard placement or user allocations.
Retained v5.6 adjustable spell/item artwork, comparisons, official Blizzard data API and existing four-bundle architecture.
